summary: Corrected complete independent review of all 135 Chinese units, 90 date/hint checks, and 32 people. Explicit person-owned Later Zhou regnal-year events remain supported, including Taizu and Shizong accessions, Bian Wei's memorial, Dou Yi's commissions and memorial, Wang Pu's work, and court deliberation. Twenty-four inherited historical-context claims and twenty-two paired hints remain invalid and require narrowly scoped source-specific holds; no canonical extraction was changed.
